messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue p95/p99 spike detected in us-east-1. GPU pool saturated and autoscaler heartbeats failing. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/abcd1234 :rotating_light:
oncall-jen: I'm paged, jumping in. tagging @sanjay and @maria. what’s the immediate customer impact?
sanjay: seeing queue depth grow on the hosted-request-queue -> ~46k inflight, p95 jumped to 2.1s, p99 ~11.8s, request timeouts increasing. autoscaler logs show heartbeat errors and repeated 429s from provisioner API.
maria: confirmed. provisioner rate limits + quota exhaustion for ephemeral gpu pools. autoscaler leader lost lock twice.
ryan: can we fallback routing to edge-region or a smaller model variant to shed GPU demand?
kai: support-bot, please open incident ticket and start customer-facing banner draft.
support-bot: Created INC-2024-7865. Notified customers with affected SLAs list. Link: https://support.redwood/inc/INC-2024-7865
jen: immediate actions: 1) enable tenant-level emergency rate limits for best-effort customers; 2) enable fallback to quantized model variant (redwood-q4b) for non-enterprise customers; 3) attempt a rolling restart of the autoscaler leader pod. assigning tasks.
sanjay: I'm on the autoscaler restart. grabbing logs now. tail of autoscaler log: ```ERROR provisioner_api.go:157 heartbeat failed: rate limit exceeded
WARN leader_election.go:88 lost lease, retrying
INFO provisioner_api.go:200 retrying after 5s
```
maria: I'll apply the fallback routing policy. command: `redwoodctl routes update --fallback redwood-q4b --scope public-hosted --priority 10`
ryan: I'll open a temporary capacity request with infra for hot spare GPUs (request id: HOT-324). If approved we can add +8 GPUs in us-east-1.
jen: alex, can you evict background training jobs / non-critical tenants from hosted pool? we need immediate headroom.
alex: evicting low-priority tenants now, using `provisioner evict --label low-priority --grace 30s`
kai: drafted banner: "We are currently experiencing increased request latency and timeouts in us-east-1 due to capacity constraints. We are working on mitigation. Updated ETA: 30-45m." sending to customers.
sanjay: autoscaler restarted, leader came up but heartbeat still shows intermittent 429s. Looks like provisioner API throttling from control plane. adding backoff to heartbeat loop.
maria: fallback routing applied, canary to 5% traffic -> observing immediate drop in GPU queue for those requests.
jen: rolling mitigation checklist: rate limits applied, fallback enabled, background evictions in progress, autoscaler restart + vendor request for extra GPUs. next: monitor p95/p99, error rates, and any customer-facing timeouts.
ryan: infra approved hot spare GPUs, provisioning started. estimated spin-up ~12m. request HOT-324 -> approved by infra-ops.
jen: realtime metrics: p95 now 520ms (was 2.1s), p99 1.7s (was 11.8s), inflight queue dropped to 8.4k. errors down 67%. good signs but still not fully healthy.
kai: support updated customers with the new ETA and mitigation summary. responses: a few customers acknowledged, one wants SLA credit evaluation — logged.
alex: eviction completed, freed ~6 GPUs equivalent capacity. combined with fallback routing and hot-spare provisioning we should hit steady-state once nodes register.
sanjay: provisioning finished, new nodes joined pool — autoscaler heartbeats stable, provisioner API errors ceased. watch for regressions.
jen: oncall update: continuing monitoring for next 2 hours, will hand off to night shift at 00:30 UTC if stable. please document all steps in the incident ticket.
maria: adding runbook notes and commands used to INC-2024-7865. also adding a postmortem stub.
ryan: follow-up action items: (1) increase provisioner quota thresholds for burst campaigns, (2) add autoscaler heartbeat backoff/jitter, (3) pre-warm small quantized model pool for surge fallback.
jen: agreed. assigning owners in the ticket. Thanks all for the quick response :thumbsup: Handing off to night oncall (sanjay) in 15m.
sanjay: taking the handoff. will ping if anything flares. :white_check_mark:
